attempts.why: Micro-Lock Plus 2.00 mm wire-to-wire product specification 5055700003-PS Rev A6: the document the archived transcription came from, re-fetched to look for a low-level contact-resistance (LLCR) row that the transcription does not carry.
The wire-to-board sibling specification the Round-3 note quotes for a 2.6 A AWG26 rating; fetched to cross-check the LLCR question.
XFL4020 family datasheet: fetched to read the AC-loss curve numerically rather than carrying a declared 30 % core-loss fraction.
ER-TFT035IPS-6 module specification: the active-mode supply current the panel allowance is DECLARED for.

rule: a value this repository could not fetch is tagged DECLARED_ESTIMATE with a stated basis, a widening factor and a first-article measurement of record -- never GUARANTEED_MAX.
what_this_is: every attempt this environment made to retrieve a PRIMARY vendor document that a D-792 DECLARED_ESTIMATE stands in place of.  A declared allowance is only honest if the attempt to replace it with a published number is on the record, and R11-06 asks for exactly that.
